opportunity.title: Document Intelligence opens new opportunities in Latin America
opportunity.description: Many organizations still rely on manual document processes, while the need to analyze, organize, and integrate information more efficiently continues to grow.
opportunity.subtext: DocumentoIQ seeks to develop this opportunity alongside partners who understand their markets and their clients' needs.

items.title: New commercial opportunities

items.title: Recurring revenue

items.title: Differentiated offering

items.title: Specialized support
items.description: Work with the DocumentoIQ team throughout the development of opportunities and projects.

items.title: Joint development
items.description: Work with our team to identify needs and build proposals for your clients.

items.title: Flexible models

collaboration.title: Choose how to collaborate with DocumentoIQ
collaboration.description: The program adapts to each partner's commercial and technical capabilities, with different levels of participation throughout an opportunity.

models.title: Commercial Partner
models.description: Develops the opportunity from start to finish while DocumentoIQ supports the implementation.

models.title: Full-Service Partner
models.description: Manages the opportunity and has the capabilities required to support the implementation as well.
models.idealFor: Technology integrators, software companies, and consultancies with technical capabilities.

profiles.description: We are looking for partners with market knowledge and commercial, technical, or specialized capabilities to develop new opportunities.
profiles.footer: You don't need to be a large company to participate. We are looking for partners interested in generating value around document automation and applied artificial intelligence.

steps.title: Step 1 — Initial meeting
steps.description: We learn about your profile, experience, and goals.

steps.title: Step 2 — Opportunity assessment
steps.description: We identify industries, use cases, and possible collaboration models.

steps.title: Step 3 — Model selection
steps.description: We define the most appropriate partnership scheme.

steps.title: Step 4 — Onboarding and training
steps.description: We support you with technical, commercial training, and support materials.

steps.title: Step 5 — Start of collaboration
steps.description: We begin to develop joint opportunities and strategies.

ctaFinal.title: Let's build new opportunities together
ctaFinal.description: Turn your market knowledge into new opportunities and develop projects with our team that transform how people work with documents.
ctaFinal.microcopy: Let's talk about your market, experience, and collaboration model.
